defs.def: to think or say that sb/sth is responsible for sth bad 把 … 归咎于；责怪；指责noun

ex.t: 此外，你的父母也可以参加专门为他们挑选的工作坊，了解前沿科学。

ex.s: The complexity of the human brain is to blame.
These biased perspectives cannot be blamed on one single cause.
ex.t: 这些有偏见的观点不能归因于任何一个单一原因。

ex.s: It's the seaside birds that deserve at least part of the blame for getting Nick Burchill blacklisted at the Fairmont Empress Hotel in Victoria, Canada.
ex.t: 所以他___24___了一个装满意大利辣香肠的手提箱。

ex.s: Who Is to Blame for the Problem of Roboealls
Of course, children aren’t completely to blame for their screen addiction.
ex.t: 虽然78%的父母说他们认为自己是良好的屏幕时间榜样，但研究发现他们的行为和他们对自己行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: Lots of people find it hard to get up in the morning and put the blame on the alarm clock.
ex.t: 很多人发现早上起床很困难，并把责任归咎于闹钟。

ex.s: The extinction of the Pinta Island tortoise is blamed on humans.
ex.t: 平塔岛象龟的灭绝被归咎于人类。

ex.s: Carolyn read the headline: Another prison breakout: faulty robotics blamed.
ex.t: 卡罗琳读到了标题：又一起越狱事件：归咎于故障机器人。

ex.s: We could also say Whatever happens, I’m sure we can all agree that nobody will be able to blame their illegal or immoral behaviour on AI.
ex.t: 我们也可以说，无论发生什么，我相信大家都会同意：没有人能够把自己的非法或不道德行为归咎于人工智能。

ex.s: Snow suspected that the water pump was to blame.
ex.t: 斯诺怀疑问题出在抽水机上。

ex.s: This time, human activity will be to blame.
ex.t: 这一次，责任将在于人类活动。
